user.title: Create Energy Report
user.description: Choose a name and source strategy.

sources.title: Consumption sources
sources.description: Only native energy and power sensors with compatible metadata are accepted.

reporting.title: Cost and reporting
reporting.description: Choose one notification entity. A notification group can be selected as a single destination.

test_notification.title: Test notification
test_notification.description: Optionally send a test before creating the integration.

reconfigure.title: Replace sources
reconfigure.description: The ledger is preserved and the new source starts from a fresh baseline.

error.invalid_energy_sensor: Select a sensor with energy device class and Wh, kWh or MWh unit.
error.invalid_power_sensor: Select a sensor with power device class and W, kW or MW unit.

abort.already_configured: An instance with this name already exists.

import_history.title: Import CSV history
import_history.description: Choose a CSV from this device. Energy Report validates it completely before showing a preview or changing the ledger.

confirm_import.title: Confirm history import
confirm_import.description: File: {filename}. Closed: {closed_count}; open: {open_count}; new: {new_count}; already identical: {identical_count}; current-month conflicts: {current_conflict_count}. Closed conflicts are never overwritten. If the open month conflicts, choose whether to keep native data or replace it with the CSV snapshot.

error.history_import_invalid: The CSV is invalid or does not match a supported schema.
error.history_invalid_headers: The CSV columns do not match the documented Energy Report schema.
error.history_closed_month_conflict: A closed month differs from the existing ledger. Closed months are never overwritten.
error.history_open_month_not_current: An open CSV record must refer to the current Home Assistant month.

abort.missing_import_preview: The import preview is no longer available.

options.keep_native: Keep data collected by Energy Report
